caption: 01 · QUESTION — What is the collection testing?. Name the wearer, use, proposition, material problem, cultural reference, price assumption, and evidence that could disprove the premise. A debut without a question becomes inventory searching for a story.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what is the collection testing? within Collection One Is Not the Beginning.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · PROTOTYPE — Which failures taught the work?. Preserve dated sketches, trial patterns, samples, fittings, substitutions, costs, and rejection reasons. These records show development without automatically deciding authorship or ownership.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping which failures taught the work? within Collection One Is Not the Beginning.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · RELATION — Who carries the first promise?. Record contributors, suppliers, workers, advisers, venues, buyers, and subjects with their actual role, compensation basis, consent, credit, approval, and correction route. Do not infer a relationship from a launch image.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who carries the first promise? within Collection One Is Not the Beginning.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · RELEASE — What must be true before visibility?. Require finished objects, verified claims, documented rights, realistic fulfillment, accessible media, customer terms, crisis contacts, and an archive deposit. Publication is a governance decision, not the end of production.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what must be true before visibility? within Collection One Is Not the Beginning.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
